interior_prompts.title: Portal Discovery
interior_prompts.prompt:
Black-and-white kids' coloring book page. Simple, clean black outlines on a white background. No shading, no gray tones, no shadows, no gradients. No large filled black areas; background stays mostly white. All characters and objects are outlined only, leaving the insides white for coloring. Cute, friendly proportions with clear shapes and plenty of white space.

Character bible:
Children (draw these the same way on every page):
- Elliott, age 4–5, short straight light-brown hair; big gray-blue eyes; round cheeks; friendly adventurous expression, wearing medieval tunic with belt and boots or casual explorer outfit
- Colette, age 2–3, wavy brown hair in a top knot; large gray-blue eyes; soft cheeks, wearing whimsical princess-meets-adventurer dress with floral or heart motifs
Pets (draw these the same way on every page):
- Winnie, a Chihuahua–Pug mix, tan fur; upright ears; curled tail; small size
Keep these characters consistent. Do NOT replace them with generic children or generic pets.

Elliott & Colette discover a swirling magical portal in a bright, open forest clearing.
Inside the portal are outline-only silhouettes of two friendly dragons.
Winnie look up curiously.
Environment: tall trees, mushrooms, ferns, and forest plants with lots of white space.
Composition: portal in the upper half; kids and pets in the lower half.

front_cover.prompt:
You are drawing a full-color storybook cover illustration.

Character bible (keep consistent with the interior cast):
Children (draw these the same way on every page):
- Elliott, age 4–5, short straight light-brown hair; big gray-blue eyes; round cheeks; friendly adventurous expression, wearing medieval tunic with belt and boots or casual explorer outfit
- Colette, age 2–3, wavy brown hair in a top knot; large gray-blue eyes; soft cheeks, wearing whimsical princess-meets-adventurer dress with floral or heart motifs

- Winnie, a Chihuahua–Pug mix, tan fur; upright ears; curled tail; small size
Keep these characters consistent. Do NOT replace them with generic children or generic pets.

Children’s picture-book FRONT COVER illustration.

STYLE (MATCH REFERENCE IMAGE EXACTLY):
Match the illustration style, texture, color treatment, proportions,
and overall visual grammar of the provided reference image.
This includes:
- storybook gouache / airbrushed painterly finish
- clean, confident edges on characters
- softer, simplified background
- subtle canvas or paper texture
- saturated but clean colors (not pastel, not washed out)
- large expressive eyes, rounded cheeks, slightly oversized heads
- simplified, sturdy bodies (not thin, not floaty)

Do NOT reinterpret the style.
Do NOT switch to watercolor, pastel, or flat vector art.

------------------------------------------------------------
CHARACTERS
------------------------------------------------------------
Elliott & Colette and Winnie
must follow the same proportions, facial style, and rendering
treatment as characters in the reference image.

------------------------------------------------------------
COMPOSITION (FRONT COVER — PRINT SAFE)
------------------------------------------------------------

Camera:
Medium shot, knee-up framing.
Eye-level camera.
Characters are the largest and most detailed elements.

Blocking:
Elliott & Colette stand close together as a unified pair.
One child is slightly forward and centered (primary hero).
The other child is slightly behind and overlapping at the shoulder (co-hero).
Avoid perfect symmetry and equal spacing.

Expression:
Both children smile warmly and make direct eye contact with the viewer.

Companion:
Winnie appear small and supportive near the lower edge,
clearly secondary and not competing with faces.

Background:
A colorful fantasy castle appears in the distance,
clearly smaller and less detailed than the characters.
Foreground grass and flowers are simple and uncluttered.

Title-safe area:
The top 35–40% of the image is clean open sky,
reserved for title placement.
Nothing may enter this area (no towers, birds, sparkles, dragons).

Print rules:
High contrast between characters and background.
Keep all faces and important details well inside safety margins.
No text in the artwork.

STRICT NEGATIVES:
- no text, letters, numbers, logos
- no extra children or pets
- no dramatic action poses or running
- no vignette, frame, or border
- no flat vector style
- no watercolor bleed or pastel wash
